name: Work on your project
description: A month at the forge, the bench, the stove or the slipway on whatever you have set out to make. Choose the project on the Gear page.

outcomes.text: Steady work, and the thing takes shape under your hands.
You found a better way to do it halfway through, and started that part again.
A slip of the hand left a burn across your palm and a lesson in your head.

name: Weapon drills
description: Forms, footwork and a thousand repetitions with the weapon in your hand, whatever it is.

outcomes.text: Forms at dawn, forms at dusk. The weapon feels lighter than it did.
You found the balance point of your weapon and stopped fighting it.
{mentor} corrected your grip and your stance in the same breath.

name: Hunt for treasure
description: Dig where the map says, sound the cliffs, comb the ruins and the beaches. With a true map it is a matter of time; without one, a matter of luck.

outcomes.text: Hours of searching, a sunburn and a feeling you are close.
Another treasure hunter was digging on the far side of the island. You kept your distance; so did they.
A single old gold coin turned up in the sand: not the treasure, but a start.
